faq.title: SafeTools PDF Studio FAQ
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our privacy-first document ecosystem.
faq.q1: Are my PDFs uploaded to any server?
faq.a1: Absolutely not. SafeTools uses WebAssembly (WASM) to process PDFs directly on your device. Your data never leaves your browser.
faq.a2: We use a combination of QPDF, MuPDF, and custom WASM binaries to ensure the highest performance and compatibility.
